-- Phase 2: implementations. No capabilities are granted.

-- Advances the generator state. Same input always gives the same output.
-- The modulus 2^31 with multiplier 1103515245 and increment 12345 has full
-- period (Hull-Dobell), so distinct steps never repeat within 2^31 outputs.
next_state(s: int) -> int =
  ex next_state(7) == next_state(7)
  ex next_state(0) != next_state(1)
  ((s % 2147483648) * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648

-- True when no value appears twice in xs.
all_distinct(xs: List[int]) -> bool =
  ex all_distinct([1, 2, 3]) == True
  ex all_distinct([1, 1]) == False
  for i in range(0, xs.len())
    for j in range(i + 1, xs.len())
      if xs[i] == xs[j]
        return False
  True

-- Returns n distinct ids. The same n and seed always give the same list.
make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  post out.len() == n
  post all_distinct(out)
  ex make_ids(0, 7) == []
  ex make_ids(3, 7) == make_ids(3, 7)
  var out: List[int] = []
  var s = seed
  for i in range(0, n)
    s = next_state(s)
    out.append(s)
  out

test_make_ids() =
  assert make_ids(0, 7) == []
  assert make_ids(5, 42) == make_ids(5, 42)
  assert all_distinct(make_ids(100, 3))
  assert next_state(0) != next_state(1)
